speaker.name: Automation Alex
speaker.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

output.objection: I did not propose we abandon containerization, I proposed we stop pretending it is the bottleneck while the rest of the pipeline is still manual. You are taking my willingness to hold steady as a demand for you to do nothing.
output.correction: I am not telling you to ignore the infrastructure, I am telling you that the current manual setup is stable enough to support the other changes we need to make first. Do not misread my request for focus as a request to freeze progress.
